title: Profit Target Control - Monthly/Daily Limit
entry_long: EMA5 > EMA200 and EMA5 crosses above EMA10, current price within 200 pips of EMA5, time filter 14:00-21:00 UTC+7
entry_short: EMA5 < EMA200 and EMA5 crosses below EMA10, current price within 200 pips of EMA5, time filter 14:00-21:00 UTC+7
exit: Close when profit exceeds monthly target or daily target; time-based stops at end of trading window
buildon_idea: Capped at 5 lots, flat-lot baseline test first; try linear/log lot law; replace hard profit limits with trailing stop
novelty_note: Money management focus (profit targets per month/day); simple EMA cross; common structure

title: Double RSI Pin Bar Correction System
entry_long: RSI(H1) < 30 and current TF RSI < 30 and bullish pin bar (lower wick 40%+ of body, body > 100 pips) on ID1
entry_short: RSI(H1) > 70 and current TF RSI > 70 and bearish pin bar (upper wick 40%+ of body, body > 100 pips) on ID1
exit: no_stop_loss; no_take_profit on first order; subsequent orders added every 100 pips with escalation; close when profit > 5 USD
buildon_idea: Add stop-loss and take-profit per order; test flat-lot vs escalation; variable entry spacing per TF
novelty_note: Dual-TF RSI confirmation reduces false signals; pin bar on smaller TF for precision; escalation in repair phase

title: Range Trading Grid - Zone Breakout
entry_long: Price closes above upper line (breakout) and stays within zone bounds; distance filter 3000 pips (configurable)
entry_short: Price closes below lower line (breakout) and stays within zone bounds; distance filter 3000 pips (configurable)
exit: Take profit 3000 pips; no stop-loss; cut-loss at 3% of balance; manual horizontal line placement required
buildon_idea: Add SL per order; replace account-wide % cut-loss with per-position management; validate zone detection with ATR or volatility filter
novelty_note: Manual zone definition (upper/lower line); simple breakout logic; capital-at-risk control via % cut-loss

title: Multi-group Dynamic Grid with Hedging
entry_long: RSI oversold + pin bar (same as EX202 logic); open order 1 at market, then pending grid 100 pips spacing; escalate lot 2x per step; max 6 orders before hedging kicks in for opposite side
entry_short: RSI overbought + pin bar (same as EX202 logic); open order 1 at market, then pending grid 100 pips spacing; escalate lot 2x per step; max 6 orders before hedging kicks in for opposite side
exit: Separate close per group: profit check buy-group vs sell-group; close when profit > 5 USD per group; hedging mode if order count ≥ 6
buildon_idea: Cap martingale at lower lot; flat-lot test per group; replace hedging mode with max-order cap that prevents order; test correlation between groups
novelty_note: Dual-group structure reduces cross-group interference; dynamic distance & lot escalation; hedging as max-order fallback (expensive)

title: Semi-Auto Modify TP System - RV1
entry_long: Manual entry from external indicator (user discretion or imported indicator)
entry_short: Manual entry from external indicator (user discretion or imported indicator)
exit: Auto management: once first order open, system modifies all orders to breakeven + 65 pips profit; grid escalation 100 pips spacing; close when profit > 10 USD; cut-loss at -10 USD
buildon_idea: Add SL per order; test different TP offset values; add internal indicator for entry automation; test lot escalation vs fixed lot
novelty_note: Modify-TP strategy = move TP to breakeven + offset after grid builds; external indicator flexibility; capital-efficient cut-loss

title: Dynamic Grid Auto EA
entry_long: Check position: if no pending orders, create grid of buy-stop pending orders; first order at current price, next orders 100 pips below, spacing doubles per order
entry_short: Check position: if no pending orders, create grid of sell-stop pending orders; first order at current price, next orders 100 pips above, spacing doubles per order
exit: Close when profit > 5 USD; if loss > -50 USD cut-loss; no per-order SL/TP; trailing profit via accumulated P&L
buildon_idea: Add SL per pending order before fill; cap grid size (max 6-10 orders); test linear vs log-add for lot escalation; validate spread cost on wide grids
novelty_note: Automatic grid creation on no-position state; dynamic distance (2x per step); minimal manual intervention; high-frequency pending order management

title: Breakout Master Bar Pending Order Grid
entry_long: Detect master bar (bearish candle body > 100 pips) on ID1; draw horizontal line at high; buy pending order grid when price breaks above line; 5 pending buy-stop orders (configurable to 10, 15); spacing 100 pips; lot escalation 2x per order
entry_short: Detect master bar (bullish candle body > 100 pips) on ID1; draw horizontal line at low; sell pending order grid when price breaks below line; 5 pending sell-stop orders (configurable to 10, 15); spacing 100 pips; lot escalation 2x per order
exit: Close all orders when profit > 10 USD; delete remaining pending orders; cut-loss at -10 USD; reset for next master bar signal
buildon_idea: Add SL to each pending order before market fill; cap total order count (current=5-15, test 3-5); replace fixed TP with breakeven+offset
novelty_note: Master bar detection = context for high-probability breakout; pending grid captures multiple entry levels; simple RSI filter for bias

title: Semi-Auto Pending Order Cascade
entry_long: Manual first order (user enters via button or EA); once first order open, auto-generate 15 buy-stop pending orders at 200 pips spacing below; lot escalation 2x per order (100% default, can adjust)
entry_short: Manual first order (user enters via button or EA); once first order open, auto-generate 15 sell-stop pending orders at 200 pips spacing above; lot escalation 2x per order (100% default, can adjust)
exit: Close all orders (open + pending) when profit > 50 USD; cut-loss at -50 USD; delete remaining pending if loss trigger; reset for next manual entry
buildon_idea: Cap pending order count (current=15, test 5-10); add SL per pending order; replace fixed escalation % with variable by instrument (BTC vs forex have different spreads); test linear vs log lot scaling
novelty_note: Semi-auto hybrid: manual first order, auto cascade thereafter; pending-order approach avoids slippage vs market orders; high lot escalation (2x) = aggressive averaging down
